headlines.name: Jared Kushner
headlines.headline: Who really owns the Albanian land Jared Kushner wants to turn into a 5-star resort?
headlines.description: Albania's Prime Minister Edi Rama has vowed that Kushner's resort project will go ahead as planned. But an ongoing investigation by Albania's state prosecutor into forged land titles could halt the project.

sources.name: Oregon Public Broadcasting
sources.title: Who really owns the land in Albania that Jared Kushner wants to develop?
sources.description: In the summer of 2021, Jared Kushner and Ivanka Trump boarded a yacht owned by Nat Rothschild, an heir to the European banking family. On the way from Montenegro to Greece, the yacht anchored off the coast of Albania. And, as Kushner told an investment conference last year, that’s when Albanian Prime Minister Edi Rama arrived at the boat to tell them about his plan for the country.

headlines.name: Army
headlines.headline: US Army to proceed with Iowa detonation of degraded bomb materials: ‘A consensus decision’
headlines.description: The U.S. Army will detonate 68 barrels of unstable, degraded bomb-making chemicals in Iowa on Wednesday morning after a federal appeals court rejected a legal challenge and allowed the controlled blast to move forward.
